statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); effort=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.effort.level // empty'); dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); base=$(basename "$dir"); tok=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // empty'); session_pct=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week_pct=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$effort" ]; then g1="($model, $effort)"; else g1="($model)"; fi; g2=""; if [ -n "$tok" ]; then tokstr=$(awk -v t="$tok" 'BEGIN{if(t>=1000000)printf "%.1fM",t/1000000; else if(t>=1000)printf "%.1fk",t/1000; else printf "%d",t}'); g2="$tokstr"; fi; if [ -n "$session_pct" ]; then s=$(awk -v p="$session_pct" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f%%",p}'); if [ -n "$g2" ]; then g2="$g2, $s"; else g2="$s"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$week_pct" ]; then w=$(awk -v p="$week_pct" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f%%",p}'); if [ -n "$g2" ]; then g2="$g2, $w"; else g2="$w"; fi; fi; [ -n "$g2" ] && g2="($g2)"; line="$g1"; [ -n "$g2" ] && line="$line | $g2"; line="$line | $base"; printf '%s' "$line"
